# Server catalog

<!-- Generated by `npm run gen:docs` from presets/*.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every built-in server, grouped by category. Add one with `wirebay add <name> to <tools>`.
Servers marked *browser sign-in* open a login page the first time a tool starts them.
Some presets have their own detailed guide: [GitHub](github.md), [Netlify](netlify.md), [Firebase](firebase.md), [AWS](aws.md).
Anything not listed works too: see [custom servers](custom-servers.md).

| Category | Servers |
|---|---|
| ai | [huggingface](#huggingface) · [memory](#memory) · [sequential-thinking](#sequential-thinking) |
| browser | [browser-use](#browser-use) · [chrome-devtools](#chrome-devtools) · [playwright](#playwright) |
| cloud | [aws-api](#aws-api) · [aws-docs](#aws-docs) · [azure](#azure) · [cloudflare](#cloudflare) · [cloudflare-docs](#cloudflare-docs) · [firebase](#firebase) · [heroku](#heroku) · [kubernetes](#kubernetes) · [netlify](#netlify) · [render](#render) · [terraform](#terraform) · [vercel](#vercel) |
| code-hosting | [azure-devops](#azure-devops) · [github](#github) · [gitlab](#gitlab) |
| databases | [mcp-toolbox-postgres](#mcp-toolbox-postgres) · [mongodb](#mongodb) · [neon](#neon) · [postgres](#postgres) · [supabase](#supabase) · [upstash](#upstash) |
| dev-tools | [context7](#context7) · [docker](#docker) · [git](#git) · [microsoft-learn](#microsoft-learn) · [mobile-mcp](#mobile-mcp) · [mobilebuildmcp](#mobilebuildmcp) · [next-devtools](#next-devtools) · [postman](#postman) · [serena](#serena) · [shopify-dev](#shopify-dev) · [storybook](#storybook) |

## huggingface

Hugging Face: search models, datasets, papers and Spaces

**Category:** ai · **Status:** stable · **Auth:** none · **Verified:** 2026-09-25 · [Official docs](https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/hf-mcp-server)

```bash
wirebay add huggingface to all
```

- **Runs:** hosted server `https://huggingface.co/mcp` (no auth), bridged with mcp-remote
- **`--variant token`:** hosted server `https://huggingface.co/mcp` (`HF_TOKEN`), bridged with mcp-remote
- **Needs:** npx

| Key | Required | What it is | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HF_TOKEN` | no | Access token (token variant) | [link](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens) |

Set with `wirebay secrets set <KEY>`.

> Anonymous by default; `--variant token` uses HF_TOKEN. Choose tools at huggingface.co/settings/mcp.

## browser-use

Browser Use: autonomous browser agent (local, or the paid cloud service)

**Category:** browser · **Status:** stable · **Auth:** optional · **Verified:** 2026-09-25 · [Official docs](https://docs.browser-use.com/open-source/customize/integrations/mcp-server)

```bash
wirebay add browser-use to all
```

- **Runs:** `uvx --from browser-use[cli]==0.13.10 browser-use --mcp`
- **`--variant cloud`:** hosted server `https://api.browser-use.com/v3/mcp` (`BROWSER_USE_API_KEY`), bridged with mcp-remote
- **Needs:** uvx

| Key | Required | What it is | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | no | LLM key used by the local agent (or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) |  |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | no | Alternative LLM key for the local agent |  |
| `BROWSER_USE_HEADLESS` | no | false to show the browser window |  |
| `BROWSER_USE_API_KEY` | no | Cloud API key (cloud variant only) | [link](https://cloud.browser-use.com/settings?tab=api-keys) |

Set with `wirebay secrets set <KEY>`.

> Browses autonomously and can act in logged-in sessions. The cloud variant bills per session.

## aws-api

AWS API: run AWS CLI commands through MCP (read-only by default)

**Category:** cloud · **Status:** stable · **Auth:** token · **Verified:** 2026-09-25 · [Official docs](https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/tree/main/src/aws-api-mcp-server)

```bash
wirebay add aws-api to all
```

- **Runs:** `uvx awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server@1.5.5`
- **Needs:** uvx

| Key | Required | What it is | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AWS_PROFILE` | no | Named profile from ~/.aws (preferred over static keys) |  |
| `AWS_REGION` | yes | Default region, e.g. us-east-1 |  |
| `READ_OPERATIONS_ONLY` | no | true = only read/list/describe operations |  |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | no | Static key (fallback only) |  |
| `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | no | Static secret (fallback only) |  |
| `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN` | no | Session token for temporary credentials |  |

Set with `wirebay secrets set <KEY>`.

## azure

Azure: work with 45+ Azure services using your Azure login (read-only by default)

**Category:** cloud · **Status:** stable · **Auth:** optional · **Verified:** 2026-09-25 · [Official docs](https://github.com/microsoft/mcp/tree/main/servers/Azure.Mcp.Server)

```

- **`--variant read-write`:** `npx -y @azure/mcp@2.0.5 server start`
- **Needs:** npx

| Key | Required | What it is | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AZURE_TENANT_ID` | no | Service principal tenant (optional; default is your `az login`) |  |

## kubernetes

Kubernetes: pods, resources and Helm via your kubeconfig (containers/kubernetes-mcp-server)

**Category:** cloud · **Status:** beta · **Auth:** optional · **Verified:** 2026-09-25 · [Official docs](https://github.com/containers/kubernetes-mcp-server)

```

| Key | Required | What it is | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `KUBECONFIG` | no | Optional: kubeconfig path (default ~/.kube/config) |  |
| `K8S_MCP_CONFIG` | no | Optional: TOML config, e.g. with read_only = true |  |

Set with `wirebay secrets set <KEY>`.

## terraform

Terraform: Registry lookups and HCP Terraform workspaces (HashiCorp); runs disabled by default

**Category:** cloud · **Status:** stable · **Auth:** optional · **Verified:** 2026-09-25 · [Official docs](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server)

```bash
wirebay add terraform to all
```

- **Runs:** `docker run -i --rm -e TFE_TOKEN -e TFE_ADDRESS -e ENABLE_TF_OPERATIONS hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server:1.3.0`
- **Needs:** docker

| Key | Required | What it is | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TFE_TOKEN` | no | HCP Terraform / Enterprise API token (optional; registry tools work without) |  |
| `TFE_ADDRESS` | no | Terraform Enterprise URL (empty = HCP Terraform) |  |
| `ENABLE_TF_OPERATIONS` | no | true to allow runs/applies (default false) |  |

Set with `wirebay secrets set <KEY>`.

> Runs Docker. Registry tools work without a token; set TFE_TOKEN for HCP Terraform. Applies/destroys stay off unless ENABLE_TF_OPERATIONS=true.

## mcp-toolbox-postgres

Google MCP Toolbox for Databases: prebuilt PostgreSQL tools

**Category:** databases · **Status:** stable · **Auth:** 3 keys · **Verified:** 2026-09-25 · [Official docs](https://github.com/googleapis/mcp-toolbox)

```bash
wirebay add mcp-toolbox-postgres to all
```

- **Runs:** `npx -y @toolbox-sdk/server@1.13.0 --prebuilt=postgres --stdio`
- **Needs:** npx

| Key | Required | What it is | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POSTGRES_HOST` | no | Host (default localhost) |  |
| `POSTGRES_PORT` | no | Port (default 5432) |  |
| `POSTGRES_DATABASE` | yes | Database name |  |
| `POSTGRES_USER` | yes | Database user (use a read-only role) |  |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | yes | Database password |  |

Set with `wirebay secrets set <KEY>`.

> `execute_sql` can run any statement: connect with a read-only database role. Other databases (MySQL, BigQuery, AlloyDB, Spanner…) work with a custom server: `wirebay add toolbox-mysql --npx @toolbox-sdk/server@1.13.0 --arg --prebuilt=mysql --arg --stdio`.

## mongodb

MongoDB: query databases and manage Atlas (read-only by default)

**Category:** databases · **Status:** stable · **Auth:** optional · **Verified:** 2026-09-25 · [Official docs](https://github.com/mongodb-js/mongodb-mcp-server)

```bash
wirebay add mongodb to all
```

- **Runs:** `npx -y mongodb-mcp-server@3.0.4`
- **Needs:** npx

| Key | Required | What it is | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING` | no | mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// connection string (or use the Atlas keys) |  |
| `MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID` | no | Atlas service account client ID (optional) |  |
| `MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_SECRET` | no | Atlas service account client secret (optional) |  |
| `MDB_MCP_READ_ONLY` | no | true (default) or false |  |

Set with `wirebay secrets set <KEY>`.

> Read-only by default (MDB_MCP_READ_ONLY=true). Set either MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING or the Atlas service-account pair.

## postgres

PostgreSQL (Postgres MCP Pro): query, explain and tune; restricted (read-only) by default

**Category:** databases · **Status:** stable · **Auth:** token · **Verified:** 2026-09-25 · [Official docs](https://github.com/crystaldba/postgres-mcp)

```bash
wirebay add postgres to all
```

- **Runs:** `uvx postgres-mcp@0.3.0 --access-mode=${POSTGRES_ACCESS_MODE:-restricted}`
- **`--variant docker`:** `docker run -i --rm -e DATABASE_URI crystaldba/postgres-mcp:0.3.0 --access-mode=${POSTGRES_ACCESS_MODE:-restricted}`
- **Needs:** uvx

| Key | Required | What it is | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URI` | yes | postgresql://user:password@host:5432/db |  |
| `POSTGRES_ACCESS_MODE` | no | restricted (default, read-only) or unrestricted |  |

Set with `wirebay secrets set <KEY>`.

> Restricted (read-only) by default. Set POSTGRES_ACCESS_MODE=unrestricted to allow writes. Requires uv (or `--variant docker`).
